title.zh: 网卡里有什么：物理层、MAC、队列和 DMA
title.en: Inside a network card: PHY, MAC, queues and DMA

description.zh: 网卡是一台小机器：把光变回比特，认出帧，选好队列，再自己通过 PCIe 把包写进主机内存。
description.en: A NIC is a small machine: it turns light back into bits, finds frames, picks a queue and writes packets into host memory over PCIe by itself.

en: how does a network card work

title.zh: 一帧以太网，和线速下每个包的时间
title.en: One Ethernet frame, and the time per packet at line rate

description.zh: 64 到 1518 字节，线上再加 20 字节；400G 跑满小帧时每 1.7 纳秒一个包。帧尾的 CRC-32 一错就扔。
description.en: 64 to 1518 bytes plus 20 on the wire; at 400G with small frames a packet arrives every 1.7 ns. A wrong CRC-32 at the end means the frame is dropped.

en: packets per second at line rate

title.zh: 收一个包要走的路：描述符要提前取
title.en: The receive path: descriptors fetched ahead

description.zh: 网卡事先取回空缓冲区的地址，自己 DMA 写包、写回描述符；一次取要等半微秒，所以路上要有几百个描述符。
description.en: The NIC fetches free buffer addresses ahead, DMAs the packet and writes the descriptor back; a fetch takes half a microsecond, so hundreds are in flight.

en: how a NIC receives a packet

title.zh: 每个包的 PCIe 开销：400G 小包装不下
title.en: PCIe bytes per packet: small packets at 400G do not fit

description.zh: TLP 头和描述符让 64 字节的包在 PCIe 上变成一百多字节；PCIe 5.0 ×16 只能跑到 400G 线速的九成多。
description.en: TLP headers and descriptors turn a 64-byte packet into more than a hundred PCIe bytes; PCIe 5.0 ×16 reaches only about nine tenths of 400G line rate.

zh: 每个包的 PCIe 开销

title.zh: RSS：托普利茨哈希把连接分给队列
title.en: RSS: a Toeplitz hash spreads connections over queues

description.zh: 地址和端口算一个 32 位哈希，低几位查间接表选队列；同一连接总在一个队列，几条大流却可能撞在一起。
description.en: Addresses and ports give a 32-bit hash whose low bits index a table of queues; a connection stays on one queue, but a few big flows can collide.

title.zh: 把包送到对的核心：RFS、aRFS 和亲和性
title.en: Steering packets to the right core: RFS, aRFS and affinity

description.zh: RSS 只管均匀；RFS 记住程序在哪个核心，aRFS 让网卡的流表直接把包送过去，跨插槽每次多一百纳秒。
description.en: RSS only spreads; RFS remembers where the program runs and aRFS makes the NIC flow table send packets there; crossing sockets costs about 100 ns.

title.zh: 交给网卡做：校验、TSO 分段、GRO 和 LRO
title.en: Offloads: checksums, TSO, GRO and LRO

description.zh: 按包算的开销靠合并变小：一次发送切成几十帧交给网卡，收到的帧并成 64 KB；剩下的大头是拷贝。
description.en: Per-packet costs shrink by batching: one send is cut into dozens of frames by the NIC, received frames merge into 64 KB; copying is what remains.

title.zh: DDIO：包写进缓存，和漏掉的那部分
title.en: DDIO: packets written into the cache, and the leak

description.zh: 网卡直接写进三级缓存的两路；在途缓冲区比它大时，包没读就被挤回内存（leaky DMA）。
description.en: The NIC writes straight into two ways of the L3; when the buffers in flight are larger, packets are evicted before they are read (leaky DMA).

title.zh: 发包的路和 BQL：发送环里排多少字节
title.en: The transmit path and BQL: how many bytes to queue

description.zh: 塞满发送环，小包要排几毫秒；BQL 只让环里排「刚好不断档」的字节，排队留给 qdisc。
description.en: A full transmit ring makes a small packet wait milliseconds; BQL keeps just enough bytes to keep the link busy and leaves queueing to the qdisc.

en: how a NIC sends a packet

title.zh: XDP 与 AF_XDP：在驱动里处理包
title.en: XDP and AF_XDP: handling packets in the driver

description.zh: 在分配 skb 之前跑一段 eBPF：一个核心每秒丢两千多万个包，协议栈只有几百万。
description.en: An eBPF program runs before any skb is allocated: one core drops over twenty million packets a second, the stack a few million.

title.zh: 网卡里的 RDMA：队列对和单边写
title.en: RDMA inside the NIC: queue pairs and one-sided writes

description.zh: 程序把工作请求放进和网卡共用的队列，网卡把数据写进另一台机器登记过的内存，对方 CPU 不参与。
description.en: A program posts a work request to a queue shared with the NIC, and the NIC writes into registered memory on another machine without its CPU.

title.zh: 训练集群里的网卡：ECMP 和包喷洒
title.en: NICs in training clusters: ECMP and packet spraying

description.zh: 按流哈希选路，几条大流会撞到同一条路；按包喷洒、网卡乱序重组，各条路才一样忙。
description.en: Hashing flows onto paths lets a few big flows collide; spraying packets and reordering them in the NIC keeps every path equally busy.

title.zh: 网卡的前沿（2026 年 11 月）

description.zh: 800G 网卡在卖，1.6T 已发布；UEC 规范 1.0、1.1 相继发布；共封装光学先上交换机。
description.en: 800G NICs ship and 1.6T is announced; UEC specifications 1.0 and 1.1 are out; co-packaged optics arrive first in switches.

title.zh: 看一张网卡时问的三件事
title.en: Three questions to ask of a network card

description.zh: 小包时每秒多少个，PCIe 和缓存装不装得下，CPU 要为每个包做什么。
description.en: How many small packets a second, whether PCIe and the cache can hold them, and what the CPU must do per packet.

en: how to read a NIC spec sheet

reason.zh: 第 2 章看第 1 章的 MAC 收进来的东西：一帧以太网和它的校验。
reason.en: Chapter 2 looks at what chapter 1’s MAC takes in: one Ethernet frame and its check sequence.

label.zh: 队列和 DMA 怎么动
label.en: How the queues and DMA move

reason.zh: 第 3 章让第 1 章的队列和 DMA 动起来：收一个包要走的每一步。
reason.en: Chapter 3 sets chapter 1’s queues and DMA in motion: every step of receiving one packet.

reason.zh: 第 4 章拿第 2 章线速下每个包的纳秒数，去对 PCIe 上每个包要花的字节。
reason.en: Chapter 4 sets chapter 2’s nanoseconds per packet at line rate against the PCIe bytes each packet costs.

label.zh: 收包的每一步都过 PCIe

reason.zh: 第 4 章逐项数第 3 章收包路径里的描述符读、数据写和写回。
reason.en: Chapter 4 counts, one by one, the descriptor reads, data writes and write-backs of chapter 3’s receive path.

reason.zh: 第 8 章问第 3 章那次 DMA 写进的是内存还是缓存。
reason.en: Chapter 8 asks whether chapter 3’s DMA writes land in memory or in the cache.

reason.zh: 第 9 章的发包路径是第 3 章收包路径反过来走，多了一个发送环的排队。
reason.en: Chapter 9’s transmit path is chapter 3’s receive path run backwards, with a transmit ring that can queue too much.

label.en: Acting as soon as the descriptor arrives

reason.zh: 第 10 章的 XDP 在第 3 章收包路径的驱动那一步就处理包，不进协议栈。
reason.en: Chapter 10’s XDP handles the packet at the driver step of chapter 3’s receive path, before the protocol stack.

label.en: Onto a queue, then to a core

reason.zh: 第 6 章接着第 5 章：RSS 把连接分到队列，RFS 和 aRFS 再让队列对上用它的核心。
reason.en: Chapter 6 picks up from chapter 5: RSS spreads connections over queues, RFS and aRFS match each queue to the core that uses it.

label.zh: 同一个哈希，换到交换机里
label.en: The same hash, inside the switch

reason.zh: 第 12 章的 ECMP 用的就是第 5 章的托普利茨哈希，大流撞在一起的道理也一样。
reason.en: Chapter 12’s ECMP reuses chapter 5’s Toeplitz hash, and big flows collide for the same reason.

reason.zh: 第 12 章的训练集群用第 11 章的 RDMA 交换梯度，喷洒要求网卡能接受乱序。
reason.en: Chapter 12’s training cluster exchanges gradients over chapter 11’s RDMA, and spraying requires the card to accept out-of-order arrival.

reason.zh: 操作系统那篇第 6 章讲驱动怎么轮询，第 3 章讲网卡这一侧同时在做什么。
reason.en: The OS essay’s chapter 6 covers how the driver polls; chapter 3 covers what the card does meanwhile.

label.en: The ring from the card’s end

reason.zh: 第 3 章从网卡这一头看操作系统那篇第 7 章的描述符环：它要提前取描述符。
reason.en: Chapter 3 looks at the OS essay’s chapter 7 descriptor ring from the card’s end: it has to fetch descriptors ahead.

label.en: A fast path that stays in the kernel

reason.zh: 操作系统那篇第 12 章的 DPDK 绕开内核；第 10 章的 XDP 留在内核里，在驱动一层处理。
reason.en: The OS essay’s chapter 12 DPDK bypasses the kernel; chapter 10’s XDP stays in it and acts at the driver.

reason.zh: 第 4 章按 PCIe 那篇第 3 章的 TLP 格式，数每个网络包在 PCIe 上多花的字节。
reason.en: Chapter 4 uses the TLP format of chapter 3 of the PCIe essay to count the extra bytes each network packet costs on PCIe.

reason.zh: 第 4 章把 Neugebauer 的 8.07% 和 PCIe 那篇第 10 章的 2% 放在一起比较。
reason.en: Chapter 4 compares Neugebauer’s 8.07 % with the 2 % of chapter 10 of the PCIe essay.

reason.zh: 第 8 章的 DDIO 只把 L3 的几路给 I/O 用，路和组的意思见缓存那篇第 3 章。
reason.en: Chapter 8’s DDIO gives I/O only a few ways of the L3; ways and sets are explained in chapter 3 of the caches essay.

label.en: Which socket the card hangs off

reason.zh: 第 6 章把包送到对的核心，还要考虑网卡接在哪颗 CPU 上，见零件那篇第 4 章的 NUMA。
reason.en: Chapter 6’s steering also has to respect which CPU the card is attached to, the NUMA of chapter 4 of the wiring essay.

reason.zh: 隔着网线的硬盘第 6 章讲 RDMA 和无损以太网，第 11 章讲网卡里的队列对和单边写。
reason.en: Chapter 6 of the networked-storage essay covers RDMA and lossless Ethernet; chapter 11 covers the queue pairs and one-sided writes inside the card.

reason.en: The interconnects essay’s chapter 9 all-reduce goes through the NICs across racks; chapter 12 looks at how those flows are spread over paths.
